name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add diced onion, carrot, and celery; sauté until softened.
Add minced garlic and ground beef; brown the meat thoroughly.
Stir in tomato sauce and Italian herbs; simmer for 15‑20 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Drain the spaghetti and combine with the Bolognese sauce; toss to coat evenly.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with grated cheese.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente; reserve a cup of cooking water and drain the rest.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, grated Parmesan, and a generous amount of black pepper.
Dice pancetta and fry in olive oil over medium heat until crisp; remove from heat.

Return the hot spaghetti to the pot, add the pancetta with its oil, and quickly pour in the egg‑cheese mixture, tossing continuously to create a creamy sauce without scrambling the eggs; add reserved pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Serve immediately, topped with extra Parmesan and black pepper.
